data.name: Natural Athlete
desc: You are proficient in the Athletics skill.

data.name: Stone's Endurance
desc: As a reaction when you take damage, reduce it by 1d12 plus your Constitution modifier; recharge after a short or long rest.

data.name: Powerful Build
desc: You count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

data.name: Mountain Born
desc: You are acclimated to high altitude and naturally adapted to cold climates.

data.name: Expert Forgery
desc: You can duplicate writing and craftwork produced by other creatures with exceptional accuracy.

data.name: Kenku Training
desc: Choose two skills from Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth, and Sleight of Hand; you are proficient in them.

data.name: Mimicry
desc: You can mimic sounds you have heard; a listener can contest the deception with an Insight check.
